items.author: vamppsych
items.text:
WHAT GOES HERE, the short version.

Anything you made. Art, photos, clips, flyers.
Anything you are promoing. Your drop, your show, your booth, your chair.
Stories. Something happened at a show and you were there.
Thoughts. Keep them yours.

Curated does not mean polished. It means you meant it.
If you would text it to the group chat, it probably goes here.

items.author: vamppsych
items.text:
NOTICE OF CHANGE OF ADDRESS.

old address: scattered. new address: 0fftheprint.com. forwarding: automatic. filed with nobody in particular. it went through.

everything made the move. the roster and their cards, the work, every event dump, the catalog, this timeline. if you were DMing me for your full res, it lives at /events/ now and you can just take it. the DMs stay open for people who like talking.

nothing else changes. the mail was never getting forwarded from a link in bio anyway.

items.author: vamppsych
items.text:
This is the timeline. If you hold a card you can post here.

Art, thoughts, a photo from last night, a bad opinion about a mix. Log in up top and it goes straight up, nobody edits you. No card, no worries, the DMs are open and we do read them.

items.author: vamppsych
items.text:
House rules are short.

No comments. Logins are for card holders only. Off the record stays off the record. The subject sees the cut before anybody else does. We'd rather lose a story than burn somebody who let us in the room.
